correctness.rationale: One-marked-player coupling establishes every conditional payoff difference, and the two-marked-player coupling proves the exact nonnegative second-difference formula under stated quantifiers. The included checker independently enumerates subsets for 796 exact cases and confirms 532 second differences; no finite test substitutes for the general proof.

value.rationale: The result provides a sharp, model-wide obstruction to arbitrarily many alternating frequency-dependent selection regimes in finite heterogeneous multiplayer public-goods games, with a minimum-sized rational sharpness example and an exact finite-sampling correction. It answers a substantive question about finite-population extrapolation of recent mixed-order nonlinear cooperation models rather than an arbitrary parameter computation.
